output.revised_prompt:
Create an original production-ready portrait mobile slot-game cabinet backdrop for Cocos Creator, stylized-concept asset, portrait 2:3. Exact straight-on front orthographic view of one freestanding, full-height, high-end photorealistic 3D vintage mechanical-style casino slot cabinet. The machine fills approximately 94% of the image height and 92% of the width, centered, symmetrical in frontal presentation, with a compact wider-shouldered silhouette and a shorter rounded lower body. Make the cabinet shape distinctive and original, unlike pearl-themed or coin-themed machines.

Cabinet design: warm burgundy enamel body; cream enamel center panels; polished pale chrome and rose-gold trim; curved chrome-and-rose-gold shoulder light structures; large ruby-red and emerald-green molded jewel lamps; rows of small pearl-white incandescent pin lights; a subtle side lever housing integrated elegantly into the outer silhouette without blocking the centered UI. At the top, include a large blank arched burgundy marquee with absolutely no writing or markings. Directly beneath it, a small blank ivory balance-display panel. In the upper-middle, create one large empty pale-cream reel aperture, clearly designed for exactly three broad reel columns: a single wide opening with subtle structural divisions emphasizing three equal vertical reel bays, but the interior must be completely empty and clean for live reels—no symbols, icons, text, numbers, reflections resembling symbols, or decorative overlap. Beneath it, a narrow blank win plaque. Below that, a compact physical control shelf with separate recessed left minus and plus button wells represented only by simple unlabeled embossed geometric minus/plus forms if needed, an oversized central circular spin recess left blank and unobstructed, and a small right auto recess left blank; keep these controls physical-looking and clean. Finish the lower body with a central faceted ruby-and-pearl medallion, purely ornamental and without symbols.

Scene: softly blurred, cheerful, upscale casino floor in the background, warm lively nostalgic ambience, shallow depth of field, no identifiable branding, no readable signs, and no competing foreground objects. Lighting: soft rose glow around the marquee, warm cream highlights, believable incandescent bulbs, crisp ruby and emerald gem sparkle, realistic chrome reflections, enamel gloss, molded glass, premium material rendering; energetic classic gambling-floor mood without harsh neon. Polished mobile-game production quality, clean silhouette, strong visual hierarchy, centered and unobstructed live UI zones.

Strict constraints: visibly a classic three-reel cabinet; one empty three-column reel aperture; blank marquee, blank balance display, blank win plaque, blank control recesses; no reel symbols; no fruit; no candy art; no characters; no text; no letters; no numbers; no logos; no brand names; no watermark; no currency symbols; no cyberpunk; no harsh neon; no black-dominant machine; no dark bar setting; no cheap plastic; no flat vector style; no clutter or lighting overlays across any live UI zone. Original design only.
